scope: Calendar event provider discovery in the shared desktop widget.

checks.command: Qt 6 offscreen execution of the staged calendar EventPluginsManager with pimevents absent. Requested default, changed and empty selections produced holidaysevents, astronomicalevents and an empty list respectively.

Golden Gate ./install --prepare verified the identical calendar widget archive and edition defaults. Verified published Tahoe archive SHA-256, release tag and matching versions. Wrapper bootstrap, update, archive and release verification tests passed.

coverage_limits: Runtime check used installed Plasma calendar plugins on one distribution. PIM Events was absent. No full desktop lifecycle rerun for this widget-only fix.
